decision: 앱인토스 첫 관측일의 행동 구성을 기술하고 후속 분석의 표본 정의를 정한다
source: BigQuery GA4 daily export, 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12 KST; BigQuery session_logs for identity audit only

assumptions.assumption: GA4 event parameter platform=toss identifies in-app Toss play, but excludes exits before the parameter is recorded.
assumptions.rationale: js/platform.js and js/analytics.js attach platform to tracked events; automatic events may lack it.
assumptions.validation: Compare platform-tagged GA4 activity with deduplicated session_logs; inspect early-exit instrumentation.

assumptions.assumption: Recorded beta_A/beta_B markers exclude known A/B testers from the Toss cohort.
assumptions.rationale: Both GA4 Toss rows and Toss session rows have zero marked beta rows in the audited window.
assumptions.validation: Check beta roster-to-device mapping coverage before claiming all testers were removed.

assumptions.assumption: The audited deliberate-action allowlist approximates actual play.
assumptions.rationale: Same allowlist as the previous spike-day behavior notebook; automatic and bookkeeping events excluded.
assumptions.validation: Audit newly added game event names against code and GA4 export.

assumptions.assumption: 2026-09-12 is the latest complete GA4 daily export for this run.
assumptions.rationale: The identity audit found GA4 rows through 9/12 but only raw session rows on 9/13.
assumptions.validation: Re-run the audit when 9/13 GA4 daily export appears.
